conformal_interval_coverage_validation.non_exchangeability_limitation_note: Conformal prediction guarantees marginal finite-sample coverage under exchangeability. In Formula 1, observations within the same race are negatively correlated (permutation constraints) and regulation/constructor reliability shifts across seasons introduce non-stationarity; hence empirical coverage fluctuates across seasons and grid buckets around the 90% nominal level.
